name: mdtero-reader
description: Read, parse, and translate papers through the Mdtero account. The plugin connects to the public Mdtero MCP service and does not include the parser.

interface.shortDescription: Papers in ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor, through your Mdtero account.
interface.longDescription: Connects to https://api.mdtero.com/mcp. Sign in with a Mdtero account. Elsevier keys stay on the settings page. Campus full text still needs the Relay helper on an authorized campus device.
defaultPrompt: Use Mdtero to find papers on this question, then open one in the reader.
Check my Mdtero setup, then parse this DOI once.
